newsitem.title: USA: Absolut plans Father's Day tie giveaway.
newsitem.headline: Absolut plans Father's Day tie giveaway.

text.p: Absolut, whose vodka marketing has turned the outline of a bottle into an advertising icon, plans a Father's Day newspaper insert containing a blue silk tie with the familiar bottle shapes in a sperm motif.

The tie, in a package with the message, "You're one in a million. Happy Father's Day," will be placed in 250,000 home-delivered copies of this Sunday's New York Times, Absolut said Wednesday. A bottle-shaped cutout in the package shows the tie inside, with its pattern of dozens of tiny bottles with sperm-like tails.

"We wanted to give consumers a fun Father's Day gift that was uniquely Absolut," Senior Marketing Director Bob Bernstein said in a statement. "The tie is a gift delivered with a wink and a smile -- but in a way that's clearly intended to pay homage to the institution of fatherhood."

The insert, titled "Absolut Dad," was created by TBWA Chiat/Day, whose 15-year campaign for Absolut is considered one of the most effective in advertising. Absolut is the best-selling imported vodka in the United States, and a book on its advertising campaign was published last year.

The company said the inserts would be in New York Times delivered in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Chicago, Dallas, Houston, Miami, Philadelphia, Boston, Atlanta, Detroit and select areas of New York City and the surrounding suburbs.
